overview_description.description:
Fulcrum is a mobile data collection platform that allows users to build custom mobile apps based on survey forms, inspection reports, and general field service management tools, and deploy them to their mobile workforce on Android or iOS devices.

Fulcrum's web management dashboard lets administrators and managers define detailed form requirements using a drag-and-drop app builder. The mobile smartphone apps support data collection (online or disconnected), with a direct focus on location-based information - all data captured, including photos, is geotagged. 

The Fulcrum system is a SaaS service, so organizations can pay for their field service automation based on usage.

about_short_description.short_description: Fulcrum is a mobile data collection and form builder software.

product.name: Fulcrum Field Operations Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for creating mobile field apps, collecting geospatial data, managing inspections, and connecting field workflows with office and enterprise systems.

product.name: Fulcrum AI
product.description: AI capabilities for field data capture, analysis, privacy protection, and workflow assistance, including voice-to-form entry, natural-language data queries, and image-based processing.

product.name: Fulcrum Insights
product.description: A generative AI feature that answers natural-language questions about Fulcrum field data and returns summaries, lists, maps, and charts for operational analysis.

product.name: Audio FastFill
product.description: An AI-powered voice dictation feature that converts spoken field observations into structured entries across multiple form fields.

product.name: Fulcrum App Gallery
product.description: A library of customizable mobile field-data collection applications and form templates for inspections, surveys, compliance, asset management, and operational workflows.

product.name: Fulcrum Services
product.description: Professional services for configuring Fulcrum workflows, developing field applications, integrating systems, and supporting deployment of field operations solutions.
